# R24 reduced original-engine repeatability screen

Declared before model processes, after R23: use first1024 vs1536 prompt tokens from R23 and the same first32 continuation token IDs, reindex positions. This is synthetic teacher forcing for determinism, not a realistic continuation or semantic task. Original untouched7fe engine only; candidate is absent. Two fresh processes per prefix, order1024/1536/1536/1024; each internal warmup plus one raw correctness repetition. Same c8192/b512/ub512/ngl99/ncmoe18/t8/tb8/Q8KV/FAon/fitOFF/mmap and frozen original libraries, resource scope24G/swap2G/floor6GiB/timeout600s/2Hz telemetry.

Check every chunk/decode vector finite/nonzero and compare pairwise within prefix. Any difference is FAIL. Two matches are only this screen, not general certification. Record first mismatch phase/position, maxabs/RMS/argmax, no speed ranking. If failure vanishes, retain R23 and state that later warmup/continuation/allocator history or other dependencies remain hypotheses. No root cause assumed and no clock/driver changes. Freeze both token hashes before first run and check each invocation.
csv_format_correction: The first launch rejected the CRLF header before model loading (exit1,40ms service runtime). This is a harness formatting error, not a model failure. Original folders/token files/freeze/runner/log remain unchanged. New -lf folders and separately frozen LF tokens preserve identical token IDs. The preregistered four-process order and all model parameters are unchanged; use run-campaign-lf.py. The rejected pre-load launch is excluded from model-process count and retained.

analysis.limits: Reduced synthetic teacher forcing; no speed or semantic quality ranking. Two pairs alone do not certify general determinism. Root cause not established.
